semantics.definition: The stage of the new 3D world: a glossy block in the base tile’s style, with a sheet of heavily frosted glass floating above it. For now only its two states are in Eidos; its drawing comes in with the new world’s elements, which change this meron.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one stage every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Be a stage in the 3D world, standing dark or glowing.

state.default: standing dark, in the base tile’s style
state.active: glowing: its borders fully, its top and its sides half as brightly
